purpose: Qualify the historical P-INFER input premise after direct P-STRUCT transfer gives no eligible new mechanism.
input: Pinned canonical TRAIN only; exact token-list sentence groups and annotated subject/object span identities. Entity identity is a span within one sentence, never cross-sentence linking.
counts: all40x40 observed reverse-label count matrix with ambiguous duplicated edge labels reported separately
inverse_rule: Count each unordered reciprocal span-pair once. If each directed edge has exactly one distinct label, emit both orientations to a symmetric count table. Ambiguous edge labels are counted separately, not silently resolved. No absent edge is treated as null.
access_boundary: Existing single-pair deployed input does not expose the other annotated entity spans/queries. Finding graph structure in TRAIN cannot by itself qualify transductive inference or deterministic inverse constraints.
interpretation: Descriptive original-TRAIN availability only; no new task mechanism, empirical benefit, independent confirmation, label-oracle input or source-paper effect transfer.
